title: fix: unimplemented mechanisms return CKR_FUNCTION_NOT_SUPPORTED not CKR_MECHANISM_INVALID
description:
pkcs11test Digests/DigestTest.DigestInitInvalid confirms: C_DigestInit with an unknown mechanism should return CKR_MECHANISM_INVALID (0x70) but wolfP11 returns CKR_FUNCTION_NOT_SUPPORTED (0x54).

PKCS#11 2.40: the distinction matters — CKR_FUNCTION_NOT_SUPPORTED means the C_Digest* family is entirely absent. CKR_MECHANISM_INVALID means the function exists but the requested mechanism is not supported. Applications use this distinction to probe capabilities.

This affects C_DigestInit, C_EncryptInit, C_DecryptInit, C_SignInit, C_VerifyInit when called with a mechanism that wolfP11 does not support. The correct return code depends on whether the function category is supported at all vs. just the specific mechanism.

Fix: For functions that ARE implemented (C_SignInit, C_VerifyInit, C_DecryptInit): return CKR_MECHANISM_INVALID for unknown mechanisms. For functions NOT implemented at all (C_DigestInit, C_EncryptInit): it is acceptable to return CKR_FUNCTION_NOT_SUPPORTED, but the initialized check (wolfP11-b57) must come first.
